title: Noor and the Border
author: Ivo Iversen
blurb: Elodie Yarrow, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
